name: Nihongo Master v1.5.7 - Precision Mouse Aiming & Shooting Fix
changelog: v1.5.7: Fully restored pixel-perfect 1-to-1 mouse aiming and click shooting in The Gallery Sniper. Fixed missing mouse shot trigger, eliminated the 1.5px movement deadzone for smooth micro-aiming, unified shots across mouse, keyboard (Space/Enter), and gamepad triggers, and added automatic crosshair mouse synchronization when resuming from pause or stage clear menus.
